title: Welcome
text:
This is a set of pages about Sam and Tom’s wedding. It happened on the Queen Mary II, approximately halfway between the UK and the USA. There is also a page of photos.
I am trying to learn to use Quarto, hence this is a bit clunky. Soz.

title: The route
text:
A first quick and ugly map of where we got married



An ugly map of where we got married. Did contours on the GEBCO geotiff bathymetry. Can’t seem to change the number of classes, but can clean the contours by using 250m instead of 100m (not done in image)





An less noisy but equally ugly? map of where we got married. I’m starting to make progress with tidying the GPS tracks now, though!





Cleaned out borders. Created a colour palette from historic maps. Could go darker in the sea though. Added hillshade multiply layer at low opacity.
